change: The five rounds together against the f90b0ce baseline, in one interleaved session. The default arm is the max-quality profile with its new defaults: weight prefetch and the modulation cache. The m5-fast arm adds the neural-accelerator Q4 kernel.

native_binary.note: The default and m5-fast arms are the same binary. The head arm is the f90b0ce build, run with --no-prefetch-weights and --no-modulation-cache because it predates both.

method: Same machine and W4 package; arms alternate in rotating order after per-arm warmups. Arm order: round 1: head, default, m5-fast | round 2: default, m5-fast, head | round 3: m5-fast, head, default

outputs.default_vs_head: 36 of 3,145,728 channel values differ, each by one level of 255. They come from round 2, the batched VAE decoder.
outputs.m5_fast_vs_default: Correlation 0.987, PSNR 28.3 dB, same composition. Round 4 is a numeric variant.
outputs.replay: Each arm produced one PNG SHA-256 in all three runs.

memory_min_profile.note: Prefetch is off in memory-min, so it keeps the serial-read timings.

dit_weight_cache_10240_mib.note: The budget was faster while weight reads were serial. With prefetch it is slower and costs 4.5 GiB more, so the README no longer recommends it.

rounds.output: 36 of 3,145,728 channel values differ by one level

rounds.change: AdaLN modulation gathered on the GPU
rounds.note: Measured against round 1 with the VAE unbatched in both arms; DiT 19.94 -> 18.33 s

rounds.change: Q4 linears on the M5 neural accelerators, m5-fast profile

notes: Each round was measured against the previous round, so the round speeds do not multiply into the final figure. The final figure comes from this session.
